sections.title: Swamp Spider House
sections.note: All 30 have to be collected in one cycle: the Song of Time brings every Gold Skulltula back.

items.name: Main room: in the water at the foot of the ramp
items.howTo: Moving back and forth in the water at the bottom of the entry ramp; kill it and grab the token.

items.name: Main room: north-east pillar (lower)
items.howTo: Crawling up and down the pillar in the north-east corner (StrategyWiki: behind the third pillar on the right).

items.name: Main room: jar left of the ramp
items.howTo: Break the jar just to the left of the ramp.

items.name: Main room: soft soil, east wall (1F)
items.howTo: Release bugs from a Bottle on the soft-soil patch on the east wall of the ground floor; the Skulltula pops out.

items.name: Main room: soft soil, west wall (1F)
items.howTo: Release bugs on the soft-soil patch on the west wall of the ground floor.
items.notes: Bugs are under the rocks in the entrance hall and in the east room. Also fill a Bottle with water here for the Magic Beans.

items.name: West room: crate in the north-west
items.howTo: Roll into the crate third from the wall in the north-west part of the room.

items.name: West room: crate in the south-west
items.howTo: Roll into the crates in the south-west part of the room; one holds a Skulltula.

items.name: West room: high on the west wall (bean)
items.howTo: Bomb the boulder in the north-east corner to expose soft soil, plant a Magic Bean, water it, and ride the plant to the west wall where the Skulltula crawls.
items.notes: The Hookshot can replace the bean.

items.name: West room: on top of the tombstone
items.howTo: On top of the large tombstone/monument in the centre: climb to the upper floor and jump across onto it.

items.name: West room: behind the upper torch
items.howTo: On the upper level, in the north-east corner hidden behind the lit torch.

items.name: Main room 2F: north-west pillar
items.howTo: Back in the main room on the second floor (via the west room's upper door): on the pillar in the north-west corner.

items.name: Main room 2F: high on the north wall
items.howTo: High on the north wall. Shoot it with an arrow or a Deku bubble, then fly to the token from the Deku Flower.

items.name: Main room 2F: soft soil in the south-east
items.howTo: Fly from the Deku Flower to the east end of the upper floor and release bugs on the soft soil in the south-east.

items.name: East room: ceiling beehive (first)
items.howTo: Five beehives hang from the ceiling; two hold Skulltulas. Knock them down with the Bow or a Deku bubble.

items.name: East room: ceiling beehive (second)
items.howTo: The other Skulltula beehive of the five on the ceiling.

items.name: East room: large jar at the north end
items.howTo: Of the five large jars, roll into the one at the north end.

items.name: East room: large jar second from the south
items.howTo: Roll into the large jar second from the south end.

items.name: East room: small pot at the south end
items.howTo: Of the small pots at the south end, slash the front one.

items.name: East room: behind the vines, north end
items.howTo: At the north end slash the vines/wall to open a passage; the Skulltula is just round the corner.

items.name: East room: ledge behind the sleeping Deku Scrub
items.howTo: Play the Sonata of Awakening to wake the sleeping Deku Scrub off its flower, then use the Deku Flower to reach the high north ledge; the Skulltula is on the wall.

items.name: Golden room: ceiling beehive
items.howTo: Of the four beehives in the middle of the ceiling, shoot down the one nearest the north end.

items.name: Golden room: north-east pillar
items.howTo: Moving up and down the pillar in the north-east of the room.

items.name: Golden room: by the ladder
items.howTo: Slash the crystal switch to make the ladder appear. A Skulltula is on the wall by the ladder: shoot it down and climb the ladder for the token.

items.name: Golden room: high on the north wall (bean)
items.howTo: Plant a Magic Bean in the soft soil in the north-west, water it, and ride the plant to the Skulltula high on the north wall (above the door to the tree room).
items.notes: The Hookshot can replace the bean. The same plant takes you to the north door.

items.name: Tree room: beehive in the tree
items.howTo: Of the two beehives in the tree, shoot down the north-east one (arrow or Deku bubble).

items.name: Tree room: roll into the tree (1 of 3)
items.howTo: Roll into the big tree in the middle; three Skulltulas drop out. This is the first.

items.name: Tree room: roll into the tree (2 of 3)
items.howTo: Second of the three that fall from the tree.

items.name: Tree room: roll into the tree (3 of 3)
items.howTo: Third of the three that fall from the tree.

items.name: Tree room: edge of the room, near the door
items.howTo: Around the edge of the room, in the grass near the front (StrategyWiki); Zelda Dungeon says one of the two edge Skulltulas crawls about.

items.name: Tree room: edge of the room, at the back
items.howTo: Around the edge of the room, in the grass towards the back.

sections.title: Oceanside Spider House
sections.note: All 30 have to be collected in one cycle: the Song of Time brings every Gold Skulltula back.

items.name: Entrance: wall by the ramp (first)
items.howTo: After bombing the cracked wall, two Skulltulas are on the walls of the down-ramp/tunnel (ceiling and left wall). First one.

items.name: Entrance: wall by the ramp (second)
items.howTo: The other Skulltula on the ramp tunnel's walls.

items.name: Entrance: ceiling behind the web
items.howTo: In the lower part of the room, burn the cobweb on the ceiling with a Fire Arrow; the Skulltula is behind it (then Hookshot the target there to reach the inner door).

items.name: Main room upper: first large jar
items.howTo: Break the first large jar in the back corner (roll into it, or punch it as Goron).
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon says roll; StrategyWiki says Goron punch.

items.name: Main room upper: second large jar
items.howTo: Burn the webs and break the last large jar in the back corner (roll or Goron punch).

items.name: Main room upper: ceiling rafter
items.howTo: On a ceiling beam. Climb onto the crates, kill it and pull the token in with the Hookshot.

items.name: Main room upper: behind the wall mask over the stairs
items.howTo: Hides behind the mask on the wall above the stairs; wait for it to come out and kill it.

items.name: Main room lower: dark crevice under the ceiling
items.howTo: From the stairs look at the opposite wall: a Skulltula paces in a dark gap along the top. Kill it and Hookshot the token.

items.name: Main room lower: lone large jar by a door
items.howTo: Break the lone large jar next to a door (roll, or Goron punch).

items.name: Main room lower: small jar on the crates
items.howTo: Break the small jar sitting on top of some crates in the back corner.

items.name: Main room lower: hole in the back wall
items.howTo: Burn the webs on the back wall to expose a small hole; kill the Skulltula inside and Hookshot the token.

items.name: Main room lower: behind the wall mask by the last door
items.howTo: Behind the wall mask near the last door (behind the stairs); wait for it to show itself.

items.name: Library: alcove behind the west bookcase (first)
items.howTo: Burn the web on the door nearest the entrance to enter. Push/pull the bookcase on the west wall to the right to reveal an alcove with two Skulltulas. First one.

items.name: Library: alcove behind the west bookcase (second)
items.howTo: The second Skulltula in the same alcove.

items.name: Library: hole behind the small bookcases
items.howTo: At the north end, pull the two outer small bookcases away and push the middle one aside to reveal a hole; kill the Skulltula and Hookshot the token.
items.notes: StrategyWiki words this as pulling a drawer on the right wall and shooting into the hole.

items.name: Library: behind the north-west painting
items.howTo: Climb the bookcase with missing books and run along the tops. Shoot the Skull Kid painting in the north-west corner to reveal a Skulltula.

items.name: Library: ceiling on the north side
items.howTo: Along the ceiling rafters on the north side of the room.

items.name: Library: on top of the south-east bookcase
items.howTo: On top of the bookcase in the south-east corner.

items.name: Library: hole behind the south-west painting
items.howTo: Shoot the painting in the south-west to reveal a small hole; kill the Skulltula inside and Hookshot the token.

items.name: Storage: crate at the north end
items.howTo: Down the stairs, last door. Break the brown crate at the north end (roll, or Goron punch).

items.name: Storage: behind the canoes
items.howTo: Behind the canoes (coffin-lid shapes) leaning on the west wall opposite the door; stand on the crates to reach it.
items.notes: 3DS: this one is on the north-west wall instead.

items.name: Storage: behind the ceiling web
items.howTo: Burn the web on the ceiling above the canoes; the Skulltula is behind it.

items.name: Storage: in the hole behind the left crate
items.howTo: Break the brown crate left of the door where the boxes start getting higher, crawl into the hole and turn round: it's above the entrance.
items.notes: StrategyWiki has this as smashing the crate as Goron.

items.name: Storage: jars in the upper loft
items.howTo: Climb the crates left of the door as far as they go, Hookshot the ceiling target on the right side of the room and break the jars up there.

items.name: Dining room: large jar under the red mask
items.howTo: Break the giant jar in the corner under the red mask (roll, or Goron punch).

items.name: Dining room: behind the painting nearest the red mask
items.howTo: Shoot the painting closest to the red mask (the back-left one) and Hookshot the token.

items.name: Dining room: crawling on the ceiling edge
items.howTo: Crawls along the dark edges of the ceiling by the walls; stand on the table to get a shot, then Hookshot the token.

items.name: Dining room: chandelier (1 of 3)
items.howTo: As Goron, Goron Pound (A+B) by/onto the table; three Skulltulas fall from the chandelier. First one.
items.notes: StrategyWiki says ram the table as Goron; Zelda Dungeon says Goron Pound.

items.name: Dining room: chandelier (2 of 3)
items.howTo: Second Skulltula shaken off the chandelier.

items.name: Dining room: chandelier (3 of 3)
items.howTo: Third Skulltula shaken off the chandelier.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.note: Kept through the Song of Time once earned.

items.name: Mask of Truth (Swamp Spider House)
items.howTo: With all 30 tokens from one cycle, talk to the formerly cursed man in the entrance hall.
items.notes: 3DS: clearing it again in a later cycle gives a Fishing Hole Pass.

items.name: Giant's Wallet (Oceanside Spider House)
items.howTo: Finish all 30 in one cycle, then go back up the entrance ramp (Goron roll) and talk to the man looking for shelter. N64: finish on the First Day for the Giant's Wallet.
items.notes: N64: First Day = Giant's Wallet (Silver Rupee, 100, if you already have it); Second Day = Purple Rupee (50); Final Day = Red Rupee (20). 3DS: any day works; he gives the Adult Wallet if you have no upgrade yet (the Giant Wallet then comes from the bank), and a repeat clear gives a Fishing Hole Pass.
